long_biography.plain_text:
Theng trained at the National University of Singapore and spent more than a decade at the Singapore National Eye Centre before entering private practice. In 2006, he co-founded Eagle Eye Centre to bring specialist eye care and newer technologies to underserved parts of Singapore. The centre expanded into a multi-clinic ophthalmology group.

His clinical work centres on corneal disease, cataract surgery, refractive surgery and presbyopia. He has participated in clinical trials, lectured internationally and continued operating as a senior consultant. In 2022, HMI Medical acquired a majority stake in Eagle Eye Centre, while Theng remained group chairman and medical director, combining founder leadership with active surgical practice.
